articles.title: AfD could lead "the first far-right state government since the dark days of Nazism"
articles.description: Voting is underway in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt on Sunday in a closely watched election. "If the AfD does form a government in Saxony-Anhalt, that would make it the first regional government headed by a far-right party since the end of the Second World War, since the dark days of Nazism", our correspondent Nick Holdsworth explains.

articles.description: Une session de pourparlers impliquant les deux envoyés américains, la délégation ukrainienne et des responsables européens pour la sécurité nationale se tient dimanche soir dans la capitale ukrainienne.

related.title: EN DIRECT - Guerre en Ukraine : les pourparlers à Kiev ont été «significatifs» et se poursuivront «aussi longtemps qu’il le faudra», annonce Steve Witkoff

articles.description: From the desperate search for workers trapped in the hydropower tunnels buried by the catastrophic flooding in Nepal to crowds of women mourning the victims of a US bombardment of a wedding in southern Iran, FRANCE 24 looks back at the week's most striking pictures.

articles.title: Germany: Why is the AfD so popular in Saxony-Anhalt?
articles.description: Voting began in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt on Sunday in a closely watched election that could see the Alternative for Germany (AfD) become the first far-right party to lead a state government since World War II. We discuss this with our guest, Hans Stark, professor of German studies at Sorbonne University.

articles.title: Ethan Hawke receives the Deauville Talent Award

articles.title: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll quits: "What we've seen is almost a factional clash"

Our guest, Walter Ladwig, associate professor of international relations at King's College London, tells us more.
